calendar_identifier.description: EventKit EKCalendar identifier (calendarIdentifier) the adapter polls and writes to. Resolved from the OS-level Calendar.app account at bootstrap (prompt 16 wizard).

member_id.description: Household member whose separately enrolled bridge and EventKit grant this adapter uses. The current schema is member-owned and cannot represent the planned CoS service principal.

provider_account_id.description: Stable content-free reference for the member's iCloud/local EventKit account; it must not equal the member, enrollment, or service-principal identifier.

deployment_target.description: This current human-member schema runs only inside the separately supervised member bridge.

workspace.description: Current member Apple sources remain in the member's personal workspace.

permission_scope.description: Exact reviewed EventKit Calendar permission capabilities.

allowed_container_ids.description: Exact reviewed Calendar identifiers this bridge may read. The write calendar must be included.

shared_container_ids.description: Subset explicitly promoted by AdministrateMe to household visibility; native iCloud sharing never grants this automatically.

binding_provenance.description: The member bridge enrollment is the binding authority for this OS-permission provider.

ownership_attested.description: Explicit review that the provider account and bridge belong to this member.

poll_window_days.description: Forward-looking window (days from now) for the EKEventStore predicate. Defaults to 30; tune up for long-horizon planning.

poll_interval_s.description: In-process inbound-poll cadence in seconds. Defaults to 60s; pack.yaml's cron is a heartbeat the supervisor uses to detect a wedged adapter.

sensitivity_floor.description: Adapter sensitivity floor. Config may RAISE the floor but cannot LOWER it below the hardcoded class default per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10.
